# Requirements Elicitation Skill

## Purpose
Convert a broad product idea into validated stakeholder needs before writing a PRD.

## Workflow
1. Identify stakeholder types, end users, admins and external systems.
2. Map current situation, desired outcome, jobs-to-be-done and pain points.
3. Elicit primary and alternate journeys, exception paths and permissions.
4. Separate needs from proposed solutions.
5. Record assumptions, constraints, non-goals and unresolved questions.
6. Prioritize questions by impact; ask one focused question at a time when interactive clarification is available.
7. Produce an elicitation log and stakeholder validation checklist.

## ClipYantra areas
Explore source rights, video inputs, clip styles, languages, model routing, local GPU availability, approval policies, connected channels, scheduling, analytics, retention, privacy and expected workload.

## Output
`docs/requirements/elicitation-log.md`, persona/JTBD notes, workflow maps and decision questions. Label every item confirmed/assumed/proposed/unresolved. Do not invent answers.
